title: TD Storage Mac app 0.2.6 and 0.2.7: Finder stays fresh and changes arrive almost instantly
text: Two updates for the TD Storage Mac app. Version 0.2.6 fixes Finder staying out of date on an idle Mac, where a file saved on one Mac could be missing on another for hours: the always-running app now nudges Finder and catches up in smaller, faster steps. Version 0.2.7 makes a change reach a Mac in about a second, instead of waiting for the next check, by keeping a question open to the CRM.
points: These are changes to the Mac app itself; a Mac gets them through the app's automatic update once the new version is offered.
Older versions of the app keep working as before.
Tested against the CRM; saving on one real Mac and seeing it on another was not yet checked when these shipped.
